name: Clean minimal
description: Neutrals only: white, grey, navy, black, cream. A relaxed tee or a fine knit with straight trousers, white leather sneakers or loafers. One dark anchor piece holds the outfit together.
rules:
No logos
Max one pattern per outfit
Nothing baggy on both halves

name: Smart casual
description: A shirt or a knit with chinos or wool trousers, loafers or chelsea boots. A blazer or an overshirt on top when it is cool. Put together without looking like the office.
rules:
No sweatpants
No graphic tees
Shoes always leather

name: Streetwear
description: Oversized hoodie or a graphic tee over wide, baggy bottoms. Chunky or retro sneakers, a cap when the hair says so. Volume on top, volume below, one loud piece at a time.
rules:
Never fitted tops
One loud piece per outfit

name: Y2K
description: Early-2000s pop and mall style: low-rise baggy jeans or cargo pants, a cropped or fitted baby tee, a tank under a zip hoodie or a track jacket, denim on denim. Chunky or retro sneakers, a trucker cap or a dad cap, a tiny bag. Light-wash blue, white, pink, silver and metallics; logos and graphics are the point. Playful and a bit loud, never polished.
rules:
Bottoms baggy or wide, never slim
At least one logo or graphic piece
No blazers, no loafers, no wool coats
